notes.decision: Candidate core regulated-services posture is available_with_limits, not blanket available.
FMA MiCAR CASP authorisation is primary legal authority for Bybit EU GmbH and its listed service scope.
Bybit EU self-disclosures require actual service availability per jurisdiction; each product remains separately gated.
KYC is mandatory for EEA users; it is a requirement, not a country-availability proof by itself.
PLN/BLIK deposit and Poland-focused PLN pairs are current supported evidence dimensions; exact PLN withdrawal remains unverified.
Earn is separately unregulated under MiCAR and stays under review for Poland.
Polish card surface is reachability evidence; applicant eligibility remains under review.
No Poland-specific positive derivatives claim from this record.
Poland marketing/referral surfaces do not bind CBW global Bybit URL/code to Bybit EU Poland eligibility.
